metric: AN-05: strong = share of pixels whose largest RGB channel differs by more than 64 after a 3x3 box blur; mean = mean largest RGB channel difference (0-255). Compared from the WebView's top to 40 pt under the page's last box (590 pt, 420 pt for search); the rest is checked as white or the backdrop. Each case passes within its value plus `margin`.

reasons.start: Glyph rasterization of the shortcut labels, the placeholder and the location button: every box (card, items, buttons) is at the captured position within 1 px. The shortcut widths come from CoreText's bold 15 pt widths in 1/64 pt, within 0.75 pt of WebKit's (Devanagari 0.62 pt wider), checked per button by theShortcutsAreSizedAndFlowedAsCaptured.
reasons.access: As start, under the backdrop, with IN-07's popup: the title, three lines and OK. The lines break between Hangul syllables as WebKit does (IonicPopupView.syllableBreaks; with CoreText's word breaks the Korean case measured strong 0.0116, mean 2.50).
reasons.search: The typed word, Cancel, the three result rows and Google's logo: text rasterization only.
reasons.en-US: The English system's WebView drew Han ideographs in PingFang SC; the render takes PingFang through the fallback language zh-Hans (StartScreenshotTests.fallback).
reasons.headroom: Each case is its local measurement (`measured`, Xcode 27.2, iOS 26.5 simulator) times 1.5 plus 0.0005 for strong and times 1.2 plus 0.2 for mean, rounded up, plus `margin`, as settings-tolerances.json: CI renders with Xcode 26.6.
